name: Violo
source:
Violo is as intelligent as he is mercurial. He's the shadow that haunts sailors' dreams, and it is by his whimsy you are brought to Pario.

[From [url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/sacrarium-pario]Itch.io[/url]]
